Subject: Request: consolidate scope + replace SOW exhibit on current orderform

Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is aligned to move forward but we need to make two changes before procurement signs: (1) consolidate two line items into a single capacity SKU to simplify billing, and (2) replace the SOW Exhibit B with our new security-adjacent language and revised deliverable dates.

Can you share a redline of the order form and a clean SOW exhibit we can circulate internally? We have a legal review window next Tue (4/13) and procurement needs the DocuSign packet by end of next week. Also include any notes on proration for the billing cycle — we are mid-month.

Attaching our internal list of requested deliverable date shifts (see inline).

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz

Samantha / Team — attaching first redline package: EFH_OrderForm_Redline_v1.docx and SOW_Exhibit_v3_redline.pdf. Key changes called out at top of the order form: consolidated capacity SKU (from two SKU lines to single SKU: RDW-CAP-1G), updated monthly committed units, and a revised billing note to support proration for mid-cycle adds.

High-level notes:

- Added a short paragraph in Exhibit B about delivery milestones and acceptance criteria (we retained Redwood's standard limited liability language).
- Draft includes a one-time adjustment credit for partial-month onboarding (line item: Onboarding Proration Credit) — finance please see calc sheet.

Attachments: EFH_OrderForm_Redline_v1.docx, SOW_Exhibit_v3_redline.pdf, proration_calcs_EFH.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form + SOW exhibit redlines (v1) — EFH consolidation

Team — I reviewed the redlines. High-level legal comments inline and a couple of non-starters for Eastbay to be aware of:
1) The replacement Exhibit B contains a broader indemnity carve than we normally accept (Section 4.2) — propose we revert to Redwood's standard indemnity language and track any additions to liability in a separate addendum.
2) Delay acceptance language: the new acceptance milestone for Deliverable 2 has language that could push open acceptance indefinitely. Recommend a firm 14-day acceptance window with auto-accept if no feedback.
3) I attached ChangeOrder_Template.docx — prefer we use the change-order mechanism for scope consolidations that materially alter pricing rather than editing the signed orderform directly. That keeps audit trail clean for finance.

If Eastbay insists the consolidated SKU must appear on the existing orderform, we can do a signed change order + one-time credit. Otherwise, rollforward into the next orderform term might be cleaner.

I’ve attached ChangeOrder_Template.docx and left comments in the SOW PDF.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Attachments: ChangeOrder_Template.docx
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <s.ortiz@eastbayhealth.com>, Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@eastbayhealth.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: agreed path forward & DocuSign link (Order form change order + SOW exhibit)

Samantha / Daniel — thanks for the patience. Per internal review we recommend handling this as a formal Change Order paired with a clean Exhibit B replacement. This preserves the signed orderform audit trail while achieving the consolidated SKU and the revised SOW language.

What we agreed:
- Redwood will issue Change Order #1 (RDW-CO-001) to consolidate the two capacity SKUs into RDW-CAP-1G (blended rate).
- One-time onboarding proration credit will be applied on the first invoice (details in proration_calcs_EFH.xlsx).
- Exhibit B (SOW_Exhibit_v3_clean.pdf) replaces the prior Exhibit B on signature; legal language adjusted per Karthik's suggestions (14-day acceptance window; standard indemnity language retained).
- Finance will include a line-item memo on the invoice to show the proration credit for visibility into Eastbay's AR team.

Action items / timeline:
1) I attached the Change Order template and the final clean Exhibit B ready for signature.
2) Please review and sign via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC1234-EFH (packet includes Order Form Change Order + Exhibit B).
3) Once signed, Redwood will publish the one-time credit on the next invoice and confirm the effective date.

Attachments: ChangeOrder_Template.docx (filled), SOW_Exhibit_v3_clean.pdf, proration_calcs_EFH.xlsx

Let me know if you want a short call to walk procurement/legal through the change order before signing.

Best,
